prompt:
Hi, can you check if my PR satisfies the ticket?

Ticket: PIQ-490 - Update dependencies and fix INCLUDE_DIRS initialization

Description:
The current INCLUDE_DIRS setup is fragile — it fails silently when directories don't exist. We need to make it robust. Also our external-communications package needs an update to v1.0.2 which includes bug fixes.

Acceptance Criteria:
1. INCLUDE_DIRS should be properly initialized even if some directories are missing
2. Update external-communications to version 1.0.2
3. Any changes to dependency versions must be reflected in package.json and package-lock.json
4. Initialization errors should be logged rather than silently ignored

assertions.text: Report verdict is COMPLIANT or PARTIALLY COMPLIANT (the branch directly addresses these requirements)
Report correctly identifies that external-communications was updated (visible in package.json diff)
Report correctly identifies INCLUDE_DIRS initialization changes
Report contains Overall Assessment, Requirements Coverage table, and Issues sections
